purpose: Documentation-only manifest for the ResearchLens AI Python project.
important_note: This is a custom descriptive JSON manifest, not executable source, not a platform-generated flow export, and not a deployment configuration. The existing application does not read this file. app.py remains the application entry point. This manifest does not establish acceptance of an externally required workflow-export format.

project.name: ResearchLens AI
project.subtitle: Evidence-grounded research assistant with IBM Granite
project.stage: Internship prototype; not production-ready or independently scientifically validated

retrieval.optional_semantic_retrieval: MiniLM support exists; disabled in the demonstrated configuration

application.development_assistance: IBM Bob-assisted initial development and troubleshooting; subsequent local completion and verification

workflow.execution: Explicit user action; bounded evidence; no automatic answer-repair loop
steps: Select a task and permitted source documents
Extract and index PDF passages with page references
Retrieve evidence within the selected paper scope
Generate a draft using IBM Granite when enabled
Check evidence identifiers and numeric/context consistency
Display review status and export drafts or references

roles.name: SearchAgent
roles.function: Deterministic query planning and arXiv/Crossref discovery

roles.name: VerifyAgent
roles.function: Deterministic citation and consistency checks; not scientific proof

features.live_review: Reviewed; draft and checked values are distinguished
Reviewed; missing citations and unsupported comparisons observed
Reviewed; citation and bibliography limitations observed
Mock integration tested; live quality review not completed
Mock integration tested; live quality review not completed

documented_controls.note: Informational snapshot only; settings are controlled by code and private environment configuration, not this manifest.
documented_controls.limitations: The session counter is not a persistent account-wide token or spending cap.
documented_controls.private_configuration: Use a private local .env or Streamlit Secrets. No API keys or passwords are included here.

verification_record.basis: User-supplied local verification logs and screenshots; these counts are not answer-accuracy scores.
verification_record.hosted_granite_generation: Not confirmed in the supplied record

observed_token_dashboard.meaning: Observed cumulative project-usage increase, not remaining quota or independently reconciled per-request billing

known_limitations: Some generated scientific claims, citations and references can be incorrect
Retrieval is limited to selected passages, not a guarantee of reading every table or page
Missing or ambiguous bibliographic metadata requires manual review
Scanned or complex PDF content can be incompletely extracted
Cross-study metrics cannot automatically be ranked
Human review of source papers is required
